svg.title: Fish farming: a managed tank layout
svg.desc: Schematic fish-farm layout with separated species and size/age cohorts, net-covered tanks, water-quality and waste management, controlled density, feeding and selective breeding.
svg.text: Fish farming: a managed tank layout
Marlbridge • Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology 4BI1 • Use of biological resources (5.9B)
EXAMPLE FARM LAYOUT • SEPARATE STOCK • WATER AND WASTE MANAGEMENT
FILTERED OR REPLACED WATER • WASTE REMOVED

g.text: Monitor oxygen; filter or replace water.
Select for growth or disease resistance.

svg.text: Different species and size/age groups can be
managed apart; covers and controlled density
help limit predation and disease risks.
Schematic example, not to scale. Farm designs and management protocols vary.
